name: Ctenosauriscus
sum: Ctenosauriscus is a sail-backed poposauroid archosaur from the latest Early Triassic of Lower Saxony, Germany, and the namesake of the Ctenosauriscidae.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: GZG.V.4191, found in 1871 at the Bremke dell locality near Göttingen (Solling-Bausandstein), housed at the University of Göttingen.
material: The holotype only, first assigned in 1902 by von Huene to Ctenosaurus koeneni and renamed Ctenosauriscus by Kuhn in 1964.
biology: One of the earliest known archosaurs, with a dorsal sail; the sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet.
author: Kuhn 1964
